description: This file declares functions and types for handling PKCS#12 blobs, including importing and exporting certificates and private keys, within the mozilla_security_manager namespace.

methods.name: nsPKCS12Blob_Import
methods.description: Imports a PKCS#12 blob into a slot, returning imported certificates and a net error code.

methods.name: nsPKCS12Blob_Export
methods.description: Exports certificates into a PKCS#12 blob, returning the number of certificates exported.
